result.summary: The image shows a signalized residential intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and sidewalks are present, the wide intersection layout and lack of physical traffic calming measures increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven patching within the crosswalk area may present a minor trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground within the marked crosswalk

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears wide, which can encourage higher vehicle speeds during right-hand turns across the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and level the roadway surface within the intersection to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and signalized control, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway and lack of a median or refuge island increase exposure time for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a midpoint refuge, increasing exposure to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and center.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, which can endanger pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane arterial road with a marked zebra crosswalk and signalized intersection. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and lack of a pedestrian refuge island create a high-exposure environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Sun Glare
hazards.description: Significant glare from the sun may reduce driver visibility of pedestrians and traffic signals.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The absence of a median or refuge island leaves pedestrians vulnerable in the middle of a wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signal Backplates
interventions.description: Add reflective borders to traffic signals to improve visibility against sun glare.
